corrections.reason: Both visually (the 3rd-order foot on the right leg of ቢ is visible) and grammatically in Classical Ge'ez (John 4:12: አንተኑ ተዓቢ እምያዕቆብ አቡነ), the 2nd person masculine singular imperfective of ዐብየ is ተዓቢ, not ተዓብ.
Closes the Ge'ez root variant quote ⟪አላ በኵሉ ገጸ መካን⟫ before the Amharic citation marker ይላል.
